parameters.name: ReportFormat
parameters.description: This parameter describes the formatting used for the report as described in {{template|BULK-DATA-JSON-REF}}. Note: This parameter is encoded as a token in the BBF-Report-Format header field and MUST NOT include spaces or other characters excluded from token characters defined in {{bibref|RFC2616}}.

parameters.name: ReportTimestamp
parameters.description: The format of timestamp to use for the JSON Object named "CollectionTime" as described in {{template|BULK-DATA-JSON-REF}}.

object.description: This object defines the properties to be used when the {{object|##.Profile}} object's {{param|#.EncodingType}} parameter value is {{enum|JSON|##.EncodingTypes}}.
